texts.text1: Do you REALLY want to do this???
texts.text2: Didn't your mother tell you that you should not spend your money in such a careless manner?

texts.text1: The most dangerous animals of the bayou are the alligators, the mosquitoes ... and the zombies! (But the zombies at least, don't move ...)
When you change the color of one square, the colors of the 2 nearest squares change as well; you must get as many green squares as possible.
texts.text2: You are only allowed to change a color when it is surrounded by the other color.

texts.text1: You again! We won't let you pass this time! See these Oxyds? You can't reach them unless you rob our Four Holy Items! But they are well guarded! Bwahahahaha!
texts.text2: Fire burns and destroys ... Want to remove blocking stones? Then dig your way to the Holy Hammer!
texts.text4: Earth fills and lasts ... Want to replace missing floors? Then build your way to the Holy Seed!
texts.text5: Air blows and goes by ... Want to jump across the void? Then make your way to the Holy Spring!
texts.text6: Water waves and shifts ... Want to trade minds with your partner? Then find your way to the Holy Yin-Yang!

function regenerate_environment()
  if(timetillnewcar_a > 0) then
    timetillnewcar_a = timetillnewcar_a-1
  else
    wo[po(0,15)] = {"st_boulder_e"}
    timetillnewcar_a = 6
  end

  else
    wo[po(19,14)] = {"st_boulder_w"}
    timetillnewcar_b = 7
  end

  else

  else

  end
  if(timetillnewcar_e > 0) then
    timetillnewcar_e = timetillnewcar_e-1
  else
    wo[po(0,11)] = {"st_boulder_e"}
    timetillnewcar_e = 8
  end
  if(timetilltreemove > 0) then
    timetilltreemove = timetilltreemove-1
  else
    for i=1, #trees_a do
      trees_a[i] = trees_a[i]+1
      behindaa = trees_a[i]-1
      if(behindaa <= 0) then
        behindaa = behindaa+20
      end
      behindab = trees_a[i]-2
      if(behindab <= 0) then
        behindab = behindab+20
      end
      behindac = trees_a[i]-3
      if(behindac <= 0) then
        behindac = behindac+20
      end
      wo[po(trees_a[i],9)] = {"fl_wood"}
      wo[po(behindaa,9)] = {"fl_wood"}
      wo[po(behindab,9)] = {"fl_wood"}
      wo[po(behindac,9)] = {"fl_water"}
      if(trees_a[i] == 20) then
        trees_a[i] = 0
      end
    end
    for i=1, #trees_b do
      trees_b[i] = trees_b[i]-1
      behindba = trees_b[i]+1
      if(behindba >= 19) then
        behindba = behindba-18
      end
      behindbb = trees_b[i]+2
      if(behindbb >= 19) then
        behindbb = behindbb-18
      end
      behindbc = trees_b[i]+3
      if(behindbc >= 19) then
        behindbc = behindbc-18
      end
      behindbd = trees_b[i]+4
      if(behindbd >= 19) then
        behindbd = behindbd-18
      end
      wo[po(trees_b[i],8)] = {"fl_wood"}
      wo[po(behindba,8)] = {"fl_wood"}
      wo[po(behindbb,8)] = {"fl_wood"}
      wo[po(behindbc,8)] = {"fl_wood"}
      wo[po(behindbd,8)] = {"fl_water"}
      if(trees_b[i] == 1) then
        trees_b[i] = 19
      end
    end
    for i=1, #trees_c do
      trees_c[i] = trees_c[i]+1
      behindca = trees_c[i]-1
      if(behindca <= 0) then
        behindca = behindca+20
      end
      behindcb = trees_c[i]-2
      if(behindcb <= 0) then
        behindcb = behindcb+20
      end
      behindcc = trees_c[i]-3
      if(behindcc <= 0) then
        behindcc = behindcc+20
      end
      wo[po(trees_c[i],7)] = {"fl_wood"}
      wo[po(behindca,7)] = {"fl_wood"}
      wo[po(behindcb,7)] = {"fl_wood"}
      wo[po(behindcc,7)] = {"fl_water"}
      if(trees_c[i] == 20) then
        trees_c[i] = 0
      end
    end
    for i=1, #trees_d do
      trees_d[i] = trees_d[i]-1
      behindda = trees_d[i]+1
      if(behindda >= 22) then
        behindda = behindda-21
      end
      behinddb = trees_d[i]+2
      if(behinddb >= 22) then
        behinddb = behinddb-21
      end
      behinddc = trees_d[i]+3
      if(behinddc >= 22) then
        behinddc = behinddc-21
      end
      wo[po(trees_d[i],6)] = {"fl_wood"}
      wo[po(behindda,6)] = {"fl_wood"}
      wo[po(behinddb,6)] = {"fl_wood"}
      wo[po(behinddc,6)] = {"fl_water"}
      if(trees_d[i] == 1) then
        trees_d[i] = 22
      end
    end
    for i=1, #trees_e do
      trees_e[i] = trees_e[i]+1
      behindea = trees_e[i]-1
      if(behindca <= 0) then
        behindea = behindea+18
      end
      behindeb = trees_e[i]-2
      if(behindeb <= 0) then
        behindeb = behindeb+18
      end
      wo[po(trees_e[i],5)] = {"fl_wood"}
      wo[po(behindea,5)] = {"fl_wood"}
      wo[po(behindeb,5)] = {"fl_water"}
      if(trees_e[i] == 18) then
        trees_e[i] = 0
      end
    end
  end
end
